Экстренное решение принимается на фоне тревожных сигналов о замедлении работы американских систем Starlink и военной сети Starshield, от которых напрямую зависит работа украинских ударных беспилотников. snippet.title: Kalah Terhormat! Timnas Futsal Indonesia Tumbang 3-0 dari Brasil di Copa del Mundo
snippet.description:
Kalah dengan terhormat! Timnas Futsal Indonesia mengawali perjuangan mereka di turnamen Copa del Mundo 2026 dengan hasil minor setelah tumbang 3-0 dari sang juara dunia sekaligus peringkat 1 global, Brasil.

Meskipun kalah secara skor, skuad Garuda memberikan perlawanan luar biasa dengan melepaskan total 17 tembakan tepat sasaran ke gawang Brasil! snippet.title: Davi Alcolumbre bate boca com Rogério Marinho após retirar PEC da Segurança da pauta no Senado
snippet.description:
IMPASSE NO SENADO — A menos de duas semanas do segundo turno das eleições, a disputa entre aliados de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro chegou ao plenário do Senado durante a discussão sobre a redução da maioridade penal. O impasse levou o presidente da Casa, Davi Alcolumbre, a retirar de pauta a PEC da Segurança Pública, proposta do governo federal e que amplia o combate ao crime organizado e a integração das forças de segurança. A decisão provocou um embate com o senador Rogério Marinho, um dos cotados para suceder Alcolumbre no comando do Senado. Marinho questionou se a retirada de pauta havia ocorrido a pedido do governo. Alcolumbre negou e afirmou que a decisão foi exclusivamente da presidência da Casa.

snippet.title: Can Cow Dung Plaster Keep Your Home Cool? | Built Desi Day 19 #architect #india #sustainability #cow
snippet.description:
What if cow dung, something we often consider dirty, could actually help keep our homes cool?

Traditionally, cow dung plaster was made by mixing cow dung, soil, sand, water and natural fibres like straw or rice husk. The soil helps regulate indoor moisture, while the fibres create tiny air pockets that can slow down heat transfer. Combined with thick earthen walls, this plaster can contribute to a more comfortable indoor environment.

But there's an important limitation. Cow dung plaster is not waterproof, so it isn't suitable for exterior walls directly exposed to heavy rain without additional protection. Traditionally, homes were periodically re-plastered. What we might consider a repair today was also a ritual of caring for the house.

And this material isn't limited to traditional homes. In Jaipur, Interior Ozal Design Studio used cow dung plaster on the existing cement-brick walls of Lambreta Café. According to the studio, the plaster also contributes to passive cooling.

This is Day 19 of Built Desi, a series on the materials India built itself with, and why we stopped using them. Start from Day 1: Rammed Earth.

I'm Utsav Kamboj, architect and urban designer, documenting How India Builds, the materials, decisions, and stories behind India's built environment.

"인스타 헬창들의 몸은 90%가 각도와 탑조명 빨이다"라며 회의론을 펼치던 세상의 시선.

그림자 효과가 0%에 수렴하는 살벌한 조명 환경 속에서도, 화면을 가득 채우며 솟구쳐 오르는 22인치 상완의 엽기적인 볼륨감.

조명이 근육의 결을 살려주기는커녕 오히려 입체감을 납작하게 눌러버리는 최악의 조건에서도 웬만한 성인 남성 허벅지만 한 두께로 존재감을 뿜어내는 기적의 매스.

"조명이 구려서 근육이 죽는 게 아니라, 팔이 너무 커서 형광등 불빛을 가려버린다"는 네티즌들의 경악 섞인 탄식.

사진 필터와 무대 조명 따위는 가볍게 비웃어버리는 대한민국 최정상급 헤비급 빌더의 진짜 하드웨어를 진지하고 유쾌하게 짚어봅니다.

snippet.title: Create easy pressure! #pickleball #pickleballtips
snippet.description:
Apply pressure on your thirds!

⭐️ If your opponents are contacting your third shot between net height and knee height, follow it in! Make them concede the net instead of giving them space to roll the ball at your feet.

⭐️ One of the biggest issues I see is players waiting for the perfect drop. They end up hitting not one, not two, but sometimes three or more good shots before they move in!

⭐️ High-level players don’t wait for the perfect ball. They follow a good ball, move forward, and apply pressure. Your third doesn’t have to be perfect to get you moving!
